description: Beyond top-level declarations, surface receiver types for methods and embedded fields for structs so cartographer's auto-placement signals can reason about ownership clusters more precisely.

requirements.description: Beyond top-level declarations, Extract must surface receiver types for all methods (associating each method node with its receiver type node via a RECEIVER_OF edge) and embedded fields for struct types (representing embedded fields as nodes with EMBEDS edges). This extended coverage enables cartographer's auto-placement signals to reason about ownership clusters and interface satisfaction more precisely.
requirements.title: Extended Method-Set and Embedded Field Coverage in Extraction

validation.notes: Test that a method on a named type produces a METHOD node with a RECEIVER_OF edge pointing to the receiver type node
Test that a struct with embedded fields produces EMBEDS edges from the struct node to each embedded type node
Test that pointer receiver methods are correctly associated with their base type (not the pointer type)
Test that interface method sets are represented with IMPLEMENTS candidate edges where type implements interface
Table-driven tests for struct embedding chains (A embeds B embeds C)
Extract on a fixture with methods and embedded structs produces RECEIVER_OF and EMBEDS edges in the graph matching expected-graph.json
Cartographer integration: method-set data from Extract is consumable by auto-placement logic without additional transformation
Cartographer can determine ownership clusters based on receiver types without additional graph traversal or external analysis
Extended method-set coverage appears in the shared proto Graph envelope without requiring schema changes

title: Extended Method-Set Coverage
